impact: Unbounded queries get slower and heavier as the table grows — a page that lists rows becomes the outage when the table hits millions of rows.
message: SELECT with no LIMIT clause in the same statement
recommendation: Add LIMIT/OFFSET (or keyset pagination with WHERE id > ? ORDER BY id LIMIT ?) and cap page sizes at the API boundary.
title: Unpaginated database query

impact: Retried webhooks and double-submits can charge customers twice; every retried payment without an idempotency key is a potential duplicate transaction.
message: payment/mutation endpoint detected — idempotency key handling not verified
recommendation: Require an Idempotency-Key header (or idempotency key field) on mutating payment endpoints and store the key alongside the resulting transaction so retries return the original result.
title: Payment endpoint: verify idempotency key handling
